Projects

Each project shows the problem, the approach and the outcome. Click a screenshot to enlarge it.

NoteFlow

Multimodal audio and video note summarizer.

Problem
Recorded lectures are long, and revising from them means rewatching them.
Approach
Whisper transcribes the speech, EasyOCR and OpenCV read slides and equations, and ReportLab builds the notes.
Outcome
A working web app: add a lecture file or link and get study notes where each point links to the second it was said. It also has a basic mode that needs no API key.
PythonFlaskWhisperEasyOCROpenCVReportLabMySQL

AgriScan: plant leaf disease detection

A convolutional neural network that identifies plant leaf diseases, with a farming chatbot.

Problem
Farmers need to know what is wrong with a plant leaf before the disease spreads.
Approach
A CNN classifies the disease from an uploaded leaf photo.
Outcome
A working web app: upload a PNG, JPG or GIF (up to 10 MB) to detect the disease, plus AgroBot, a chat assistant for crop suggestions, pest problems, weather and market prices.
CNNDeep learningWeb app

Landslide detection

Multi-label classification to detect landslides caused by torrential rain.

Problem
Torrential rain triggers landslides that are hard to spot in time.
Approach
A deep learning model with multi-label classification.
Outcome
A trained multi-label model that detects rain-triggered landslides, shown in a web dashboard for disaster detection and impact prediction. It has a hazard overview, impact prediction, gender and vulnerability, and early warning views.
Deep learningMulti-label classification

IoT air quality monitor

IoT system that monitors the air quality index (AQI).

Problem
Local air quality is hard to see without a measuring device.
Approach
Sensors on an IoT setup that track the air quality index (AQI).
Outcome
AirSense, a monitoring dashboard that reads MQ-2, MQ-135, MQ-7 and DHT22 sensors and shows an indoor air quality index with alarms and analytics. The screenshot uses simulated demo data.
IoT
In progress

Camera attendance system

Standalone edge device that marks attendance for a college.

Problem
Marking attendance for a college takes manual effort.
Approach
A standalone edge device with a camera, running OpenCV.
Outcome
